purpose: Name a representative first example before a broader group.

Noun + をはじめ; noun + をはじめとする + noun

It is sold in major cities including Tokyo.
I studied various cultural traditions, including the tea ceremony.
formation: Noun + をはじめ; noun + をはじめとする + noun
restrictions: The first item is prominent or representative; the list is not exhaustive.
mistake: This is an example-list expression, not the verb 始める meaning begin.
